milestoneAcceptance: M10.S1: M10 ledger lands first; locks M10 scope to (a) OWNER_DECISIONS.md canonical doc + (b) dirty-tree audit (axi-agent + workspace-governance, read-only) + (c) 9-ledger consistency audit (read-only) + (d) canonical owner-decision list compilation (read-only)

M10.S4 (Track C — 9-ledger consistency): 40 unique loreTrail SHAs verified (39 on axi-agent dev + 1 on governance feature/audit-docs); 4 schema-drift candidates identified; 2 cross-milestone duplicate decisions found; 1 bookkeeping gap (TODO-m6-track-5 missing resolution block)

M10.S99: full Node suite 183/183 pass; swift run AxiTodoStoreSmokeTests pass; M10 ledger closed; 2 commits on dev (OWNER_DECISIONS.md + this ledger)
